about: What the in-app chapter-link setup guide (web/index.html, #fetcherWizard) and fetcher/README.md rely on outside this repository. scripts/check-guide.mjs re-reads these every week (.github/workflows/guide-check.yml) and opens an issue when one changed; after reviewing the guide against the changed page, update its dateModified here and "checked" (the app shows that date).

pages.uses: Step 3: Workers & Pages → Create application → GitHub → select the repository → Save and Deploy; the Worker name must match the name in wrangler.toml
Step 3 settings: Root directory, Build command (optional), Deploy command npx wrangler deploy
Step 4: Worker → Settings → Variables and Secrets → Add → Secret → Deploy
Free plan: 10 ms CPU per request, 100,000 requests a day (README, error messages)
